    key = os.environ['SARVAM_API_KEY']
    # Create a minimal silent WAV \(44 bytes header + some silence\)

    buf = io.BytesIO\(\)
    with wave.open\(buf, 'wb'\) as w:

import sys

# Copy the relevant sets and function from main.py
_HINGLISH_WORDS = frozenset\([
    "mera", "meri", "mujhe", "hamara", "hamare", "tumhara",
    "kya", "kaise", "kaisa", "kyun", "kab", "kahan", "kitna", "kitni",
    "hai", "hain", "tha", "thi", "hoga", "hogi",
    "nahi", "haan",
    "chahiye", "chahte",
    "kar", "karo", "karna", "karein", "karta", "karti",
    "bata", "batao", "batana",
    "aap", "tum", "hum", "woh", "yeh",
    "aur", "lekin", "toh", "bhi", "sirf", "bahut", "thoda",
    "abhi", "pehle", "baad",
    "accha", "theek", "bilkul", "shukriya",
    "ji",
    "mere", "tera", "teri", "uska", "uski",
]\)

def classify_en_transcript\(en_tr\):
    """Returns True if en-IN transcript represents genuine English speech."""
    if not en_tr:
        return False
    en_words = set\(en_tr.lower\(\).split\(\)\)
    en_roman = len\(re.findall\(r'[a-zA-Z]', en_tr\)\)
    en_all_alpha = len\(re.findall\(r'[a-zA-Z\\u0900-\\u097F]', en_tr\)\)
    en_roman_ratio = en_roman / max\(1, en_all_alpha\)
    has_hinglish = bool\(en_words & _HINGLISH_WORDS\)
    has_devanagari_in_en = bool\(re.search\(r'[\\u0900-\\u097F]', en_tr\)\)
    
    is_english = \(
        en_roman_ratio > 0.8
        and not has_hinglish
        and not has_devanagari_in_en
        and len\(en_words\) >= 2
    \)
    return is_english, {
        "roman_ratio": round\(en_roman_ratio, 2\),
        "has_hinglish": has_hinglish,
        "has_deva": has_devanagari_in_en,
        "word_count": len\(en_words\),
        "hinglish_matches": list\(en_words & _HINGLISH_WORDS\),
    }

# Test cases: \(en-IN transcript, expected=English?, description\)
tests = [
    # --- English speech: en-IN should give clean Roman ---
    \("how much data is left in my account", True, "EN: data balance query"\),
    \("what is my current plan", True, "EN: plan query"\),
    \("my bill is not paid yet", True, "EN: billing query"\),
    \("network not working", True, "EN: network issue"\),
    \("what are my data usage details", True, "EN: data usage"\),
    \("I want to recharge my account", True, "EN: recharge"\),
    \("check my balance please", True, "EN: balance check"\),
    \("how much internet do I have left", True, "EN: internet check"\),
    
    # --- Hindi/Hinglish speech: en-IN gives Roman Hindi ---
    \("mera balance kitna hai", False, "HI: balance in Hinglish"\),
    \("mera data check karo", False, "HI: data check Hinglish"\),
    \("internet slow hai bahut", False, "HI: network slow Hinglish"\),
    \("kya mera plan valid hai", False, "HI: plan query Hinglish"\),
    \("mere account mein kitna data bacha hai", False, "HI: data remaining"\),
    \("speed bahut slow hai", False, "HI: speed slow"\),
    \("recharge karna hai mujhe", False, "HI: recharge Hinglish"\),
    \("nahi chal raha network", False, "HI: not working Hinglish"\),
    
    # --- Edge cases ---
    \("", False, "EDGE: empty transcript"\),
    \("okay", False, "EDGE: single word \(too short\)"\),
    \("yes please", True, "EDGE: 2-word English"\),
    \("ok theek hai", False, "EDGE: mixed ok+theek+hai"\),
]

passed = 0
failed = 0
for en_tr, expected, desc in tests:
    result, details = classify_en_transcript\(en_tr\)
    status = "PASS" if result == expected else "FAIL"
    if result != expected:
        failed += 1
    else:
        passed += 1
    print\(f"{status} | {desc}"\)
    if status == "FAIL":
        print\(f"     en_tr={en_tr!r}"\)
        print\(f"     expected={expected}, got={result}"\)
        print\(f"     details={details}"\)

print\(f"\\n{passed}/{passed+failed} tests passed"\)
